query:
WITH target AS (
            SELECT game_id
            FROM rb_team_member
            WHERE team_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
        ), updated AS (
            UPDATE rb_team_member
            SET is_captain = (user_id = $2)
            WHERE team_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
            RETURNING 1
        )
        SELECT game_id FROM target;
